defect: reset release is synchronized on a clock different from the receiver clock
rationale: The reset pipeline advances on clk_aux, but data_o is released asynchronously by that pipeline while operating on clk_main; the two clocks are unrelated.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Kept a two-stage reset-release pipeline and reduced the consumer to one register.

mutation.description: Clocked the reset-release stages with clk_aux while applying the release to a clk_main register.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: clk_main reset released by a synchroniser clocked by clk_aux, so release is async to clk_main.
